en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, unpaved main street lined with single‑story buildings with arched windows and doors on both sides. Rows of evenly spaced trees, including some taller palms further back, form an avenue effect, while people in light clothing stand or walk along the street. The image is framed decoratively, with printed captions in red at the bottom and a vertical publisher credit along the left margin.
